name: SIGNATURE
behaviour_and_version_notes: v=1: client quits. v=0: client quits unless the connected host string is 127.0.0.1. Any other v: ignored. Value is stored in a global too. Identical in 2.31.

name: LEVELMODTIME
behaviour_and_version_notes: Handed unparsed to the active gmap/level object, only if one exists (needs active level set by 156/49). Identical in 2.31.

name: STARTMESSAGE
behaviour_and_version_notes: Trimmed; if it begins with the RTF header it is stored as servermessage.rtf else servermessage.html in the data dir; if identical to the stored copy nothing happens; otherwise file rewritten and shown in the start-message viewer (RTF) or loaded as lines (HTML). Identical in 2.31.

name: HASNPCSERVER
behaviour_and_version_notes: Sets a 'server has NPC server' flag via a method with arg 1. NOT handled in 2.31 (falls to the default arm).

name: (PLO 46)
behaviour_and_version_notes: Only when current level is the active level; calls a per-player method with the rest and flag 1. Not asked, listed for completeness.

name: STAFFGUILDS
behaviour_and_version_notes: Stored as a comma-separated list via SetCommaText into a global string list.

name: PLAYERWARP2
payload_fields: GCHAR x2, GCHAR y2, GCHAR z(ignored here), GCHAR gmapX, GCHAR gmapY, rest = level name
behaviour_and_version_notes: x and y are half-tile steps: value/2.0 gives tiles. gmapX/gmapY are only applied when the level name ends in .gmap: they are clamped to the gmap grid, then the level name is replaced by the name of the gmap cell. Then the client warps. 2.31 differs by ~5 instructions only (no wire change found).

name: LARGEFILESTART
behaviour_and_version_notes: Stores the file name. 2.31 additionally clears the stored large-file size.

name: LARGEFILEEND
behaviour_and_version_notes: If equal to stored name, clears it; then the file's accumulated stream is rewound and processed as a received file.

name: PROFILE
behaviour_and_version_notes: First field = account the profile belongs to; remaining fields = profile lines. Delivered to the profile window of the matching open player; if no exact match, to the best matching entry in the player list.

name: LARGEFILESIZE
behaviour_and_version_notes: 5-char number (shifts 28,21,14,7,0) stored in a global. Unhandled in 2.17/2.22.

name: RAWDATA
behaviour_and_version_notes: Sets 'raw data pending' and the byte count (shifts 14,7,0). The next line-framed packet is read as that many raw bytes.

name: NPCDEL2
payload_fields: GCHAR n, level name (n chars), GINT3 npc id
behaviour_and_version_notes: Looks the level up by name, finds NPC by id in that level's list and removes it.

name: HIDENPCS
behaviour_and_version_notes: In the active level: every NPC whose id is 1..999 is removed.

name: SAY2
behaviour_and_version_notes: Shown as an NPC sign message; resets some talk/lock state. Offsets differ in 2.31.

name: FREEZEPLAYER2
behaviour_and_version_notes: Freezes the local player (skips if some dialog/mode is active).

name: UNFREEZEPLAYER
behaviour_and_version_notes: Unfreezes local player.

name: SETACTIVELEVEL
behaviour_and_version_notes: Extension .gmap: loads/gets the gmap and makes it the active level; else looks the level up by name. 2.31 adds a follow-up step after it (an extra call with all-zero arguments and then another call) that is not in 2.17/2.22; its purpose is not resolved.

name: MOVE
payload_fields: GINT3 npc id, rest = move data
behaviour_and_version_notes: Id > 0 required; rest passed to the NPC movement routine.

name: SHOWIMGNPC
behaviour_and_version_notes: Finds NPC by id in the active level's list; applies the prop list to it.

name: UNKNOWN168
behaviour_and_version_notes: Calls a local-player routine with flag 1 (client-side reset). Payload ignored.

name: UPGRADEURL
behaviour_and_version_notes: Stored as the upgrade/reconnect URL.

name: GHOSTMODE
behaviour_and_version_notes: flag>0 means ghost on. Only the first byte is used.

name: BIGMAP
payload_fields: comma text >=2 fields (>=4 to be used): txt, png, x, y
behaviour_and_version_notes: Fields 2,3 parsed as floating point; 171 and 172 share one routine, split by id.

name: MINIMAP
behaviour_and_version_notes: Same field layout as 171 but goes to the minimap routine.

name: GHOSTTEXT
behaviour_and_version_notes: Stored as the ghost-mode text.

name: GHOSTICON
behaviour_and_version_notes: flag>0 shows the ghost icon.

name: SHOOT
payload_fields: GSHORT player id, rest = shot data
behaviour_and_version_notes: Only when the current level equals the active level; rest passed to the shoot handler of that player.

name: KINGDOMSMODE
behaviour_and_version_notes: Switches the main form to Kingdoms mode.

name: NEWWORLDMODE
behaviour_and_version_notes: Switches the main form to New World mode.

name: SERVERWARP
payload_fields: comma text, at least 4 fields; fields 1,2,3 used (field 0 ignored)
behaviour_and_version_notes: The three fields go to a connect-to-other-server routine (first looks like a server name, the other two are stored as two further strings). Exact meaning of each not resolved.

name: RPGWINDOW
behaviour_and_version_notes: Creates the RPG window form on first use, then gives it the text.

name: STATUSLIST
behaviour_and_version_notes: Passed to the status-list form if it exists.

name: UNKNOWN181
behaviour_and_version_notes: Sets a boolean on that player (toggle>0). Payload length >=3 required.

name: LISTPROCESSES
behaviour_and_version_notes: Client builds a process list and answers with PLI 44 (0x2c).

name: HASPROCESSRUNNING
behaviour_and_version_notes: Client answers with PLI 45 (0x2d), 1 GCHAR: 1 if the server's string occurs in the client's own process list, else 0.

name: TAKESCREENSHOT
behaviour_and_version_notes: Only accepted if the extension is .png; saves a screenshot into the screenshots sub-folder under that base name. No reply sent from this routine.

name: BOARDHEIGHTS
payload_fields: GCHAR mapX, GCHAR mapY, GCHAR blockX, GCHAR blockY, GCHAR w-1, GCHAR h-1, then (w)*(h) cells of 2 raw bytes
behaviour_and_version_notes: mapX/mapY index the gmap cell and must be inside the gmap grid; each cell = (byte0-0x20-0x32) + (byte1-0x20)/128.0 (height with fraction). Cells are row-major. Heights are written to that level's 9-columns-per-row height grid starting at blockX,blockY; change threshold 1/16 triggers a redraw. Length check is only (w*h+6), so cells must be sent in full.

name: BOARDMODIFY2
payload_fields: GCHAR mapX, GCHAR mapY, GCHAR x, GCHAR y, GCHAR w, GCHAR h, then w*h GSHORT tiles (row-major), rest = ignored padding
behaviour_and_version_notes: mapX/mapY select the gmap cell (bounds-checked), tiles replace the cell's board starting at x,y. Requires length >= 6+2*w*h. Bytes after the tiles are ignored (lab with injected frames, 2.22 and 2.31: a second record in the trailer is not applied; one byte short is dropped silently with no disconnect; a block past board column 63 is clipped). Table: lab-boardmodify2-186-trailer.tsv.

name: MOVE2
behaviour_and_version_notes: Same shape as 165 but the routine is called with an extra flag = 1. Unhandled in 2.17/2.22.
